resource_usage_with_unique_service_match.reservation_interpretation: Finished unknown-attempt charged reservations are actual accounting records, not measured usage. limitations: The extra service completion has no client model_attempt finished/model_response/world action receipt; it is resource evidence only.
Server created timestamp has seconds precision and does not prove client receipt.
Actual tokens spent on four failed D1 inference attempts remain unknown, not zero.
No synthetic terminal meter, reward or episode-end snapshot was made for the interrupted open case.
This resource addition does not modify original V, Mapper, training support or the planned sampling denominator.
No large HTTP prompt, token array or world snapshot is copied; original files are indexed by hashes.
